policy: Limits are ratchets. Lower them after reductions; raise them only with an explicit context-budget justification.
adjustment_justification: Validated lookup indices now live in the schema-of-record IR and explicit per-executor tuning now lives in sembla-cpu; their local increases replace downstream scans and process-global state. The serde state-header rewrite and backend simplifications reduce the whole backend by 2,104 tokens, so the total and unaffected crate limits are ratcheted down.
